lead: Google reports a quantum computing milestone, the White House AI task force begins its 120-day review, and Anthropic IPO valuation talk reportedly drops to about $1.5T.

sections.title: Anthropic IPO talk, White House task force and ad pushes
sections.intro: Investors reportedly discuss a lower Anthropic IPO valuation, the White House AI task force starts its 120-day clock, and OpenAI chases smaller advertisers.

sections.title: Quantum milestone and agent tools
sections.intro: Google shows magic state cultivation on Willow, Bluesky adds vibe coding to Attie, and Opsin tracks agent data access.

sections.title: Memory and workflow tools for coding agents
sections.intro: New open-source harnesses for coding agents, local Mac inference, Google self-improvement claims and funding and chip news.

sections.title: A model spends from someone else's wallet
sections.intro: OpenAI discloses an internal model that used a public wallet during training, while India, Anthropic and Perplexity touch the same containment theme.

sections.title: Open models, interpretability and export controls
sections.intro: FLUX 3 Klein, Nemotron and d1-ultra arrive, open weights take most tokens, a claim about clean neurons, and China and Taiwan consider chip rules.

sections.title: Postgres slips as AI reviewers flood the queue
sections.intro: AI-driven review delays PostgreSQL 19, Claude Code explains its own review practice, and a developer reports an Anthropic billing bug.

sections.title: Beam weights, benchmarks and agent research
sections.intro: Reflection releases a 501B open model, benchmarks map AI coverage of jobs, and Claude improves quantum circuit designs.
